decisions.decision: Resume now. The usage limit from 2026-10-15 has reset. The improver's context is stale, so start a new improver on runs/d0-r2/digest.md instead of sending it a message. Use Sonnet for the runs and the improver. Keep Fable as the rubric reviewer. (1) Finish Day 0 round 2: apply the improver's edits to the prompts and OS files, rerun each failing Day 0 prompt in a fresh `claude -p` session against sim keys, and review it against all 7 plan items. (2) Do the same loop for Days 1, 2 and 3 using the T-461 harness. Repeat until every prompt passes every rubric item. Cap it at 4 rounds per prompt; anything still failing becomes its own fix task. (3) Create workshop-plan/research/revops-os-test-log.md. It does not exist yet. For each prompt and round, record the rubric scores, the edits, and the transcript paths. (4) Commit and push to our repo. Leave Codex out. Then move the task to review for Adi.

Log every round and push after each day. (5) Move the task to review for Adi and Bharath.
